description: This file defines an interface class 'WebAudioClientBackendInterface' for Web Audio backend operations within the 'firebolt::rialto::client' namespace. It declares virtual methods for creating, destroying, and controlling Web Audio playback, as well as querying device info and volume control.

classes.name: WebAudioClientBackendInterface
classes.description: An interface class providing virtual methods for Web Audio backend management and control.

methods.name: createWebAudioBackend
methods.description: Creates a Web Audio backend with specified client, MIME type, priority, and configuration.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Sets the end of stream for Web Audio.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves the number of available buffer frames.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves the buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio data to the buffer.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device information including preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.
